comment.es: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Varios</title><remarkFreeText><translation>La enmienda 1 se ha retirado y la enmienda 5 se ha anulado.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.cs: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Různé</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Pozměňovací návrh 1 byl vzat zpět a pozměňovací návrh 5 byl zrušen.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.sl: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Razno</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Predlog spremembe 1 je bil umaknjen, predlog spremembe 5 pa razveljavljen.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.nl: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Diversen</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Amendement 1 a is ingetrokken en amendement 5 a is geschrapt.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.lt: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Įvairūs</title><remarkFreeText><translation>1 pakeitimas buvo atšauktas, o 5 a pakeitimas buvo panaikintas.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.lv: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Dažādi</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Grozījums Nr. 1.a bija atsaukts un grozījums Nr. 5.a bija atcelts.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.fr: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Divers</title><remarkFreeText><translation>L'amendement 1 a été retiré et l'amendement 5 a été annulé.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.it: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Varie</title><remarkFreeText><translation>L'emendamento 1 è stato ritirato e l'emendamento 5 è stato annullato.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.da: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Diverse</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Ændringsforslag 1 a blev trukket tilbage, og ændringsforslag 5 a bortfaldt.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.ro: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Diverse</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Amendamentul 1 a fost retras și amendamentul 5 a fost anulat.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.sk: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Iné</title><remarkFreeText><translation>PN 1 bol vzatý späť a PN 5 bol zrušený.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.sv: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Övriga frågor</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Ändringsförslag 1 hade dragits tillbaka och ändringsförslag 5 hade strukits.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.pt: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Diversos</title><remarkFreeText><translation>A alteração 1 foi retirada e a alteração 5 caducou.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.ga: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Aon ghnó eile</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Tarraingíodh siar leasú 1 agus cuireadh leasú 5 ar ceal.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.en: <remarkFreeTexts order="3"><title>Miscellaneous</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Amendment 1 had been withdrawn and Amendment 5 had been cancelled.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
